headline: Stlican Shelf Joins Weathered Expanse at Head of Base-Change Ledger
war_summary: Since the last issue, the freshest field returns place Stlican Shelf at the head of the newest two-hour file, with eleven strategic-base events and a daily ledger grown from thirty-eight to forty-six. The Weathered Expanse is close behind with eight events in the latest two hours and fifty-two across the day; Linn Mercy follows with six recent events and nineteen daily. Callahan’s Passage logs four recent changes, Viper Pit three, and Marban Hollow two. DeadLands, which figured prominently earlier, has been quiet since about 02:45, while Godcrofts, despite a strong twenty-one-event daily count, has only one mark in the latest six-hour window. Casualty returns remain steepest in the Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, and Callahan’s Passage, and the latest two-hour enlistment trends are mixed: several busy sectors are still accelerating even as the Expanse cools. No army has been declared winner, and thirty-four victory towns are still required.
